[[File:Sapflowers.jpg|thumb|250px|Sapflowers]]
The '''sapflower''' was a [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. Sapflowers grew along the shorelines of [[river]]s and gave a tasty nectar.

The [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] [[Jak Chucka]] came to [[Theed/Legends|Theed]] every year to collect sapflower juice. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he asked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to get the juice for him, as he was too afraid of wild animals roaming the area.
